text: Y2K: early-2000s revival aesthetic - low-rise silhouettes, metallics, logomania, butterfly motifs, bold graphics, nostalgic pop-culture references.
Elevated basics: minimal, quality-forward essentials in neutral tones - clean silhouettes, muted color palettes, subtle branding, understated over loud.
Loud streetwear: bold graphics, statement logos, bright or clashing colors, oversized fits - designed to draw attention rather than blend in.
Nostalgic: styles referencing past decades or earlier personal/cultural eras - vintage graphics, throwback silhouettes, retro color palettes.
Minimalist: pared-back design with few decorative elements - solid colors, simple cuts, little to no graphic print or branding.
Maximalist: layered, decorative, more-is-more design - mixed prints, bold color combinations, multiple statement pieces at once.
Quiet luxury: understated, high-quality pieces that signal wealth through fabric and fit rather than visible branding or logos.
Gorpcore: outdoor/hiking-inspired utility wear used as everyday fashion - technical fabrics, multi-pocket jackets, earth tones, functional details.
